flora: Ginkgo Leaf (deeply lobed, fan-shaped with fine parallel veins)
Ginkgo Seeds (fleshy, round, pale-yellow to silver-orange)
Ginkgo Sapling (stiff, upright stem with clusters of small fans)
Bark detail (light grey-brown, becoming corky and deeply fissured with age)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the graphic 'fan' shape; vibrant yellow-green foliage; tactile, corky bark; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single, deeply-lobed leaf; Top-Right: A cluster of fleshy seeds on a twig; Bottom-Left: A small, stiff sapling; Bottom-Right: A close-up of the corky, light-grey bark.
visual_logic.ground: Red-brown earth lightly dusted with fallen yellow-green leaves.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even daylight to emphasize the delicate parallel veins in the leaves.
